title: Added trusted compute inputs and one authoritative execution path
points: Deterministic models and screens now check scoped pipeline quality flags before arithmetic; models stop on relevant blockers and market screens exclude blocked observations with coverage disclosure.
ROIC, dividend-yield, and FCF-yield computes no longer collide with valid Router evidence plans; conflicting closed-compute plans receive one Router-authored corrective retry.
Closed computes are rejected when the query does not authorize them, and all-caps prose is no longer misread as a list of unknown ticker symbols.
Selector handoffs now support explicit ask IDs and dependencies so downstream lanes cannot silently broaden when a selector returns no evidence-backed tickers.
The upstream unit contract now preserves values already reported in thousands, including Rupees in thousand labels, while retaining ambiguity flags for repair visibility.
